'''Anthony Alfieri''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Phoenix tournament]] on 1 June 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Mains]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2415">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01d2415/ viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 6 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01d2415/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
